name: Dynamic Shared LM Output Vectors

main_jobs.why: Vuk Rosic existing function-preserving additive shared LM output head
EMNLP 2024 supervised syntax-neighbour signal sharing comparator
historical positive-target gradient-based dynamic groups with direction plus calibrated magnitude

short_ablation_jobs.why: does direction add the gain without gradient magnitude?
rule out Adam-moment reset / regroup frequency artifact

evaluations: PRIMARY: independent FineWeb-Edu held-out next-token NLL >=50M tokens excluding no real GPT-2 vocabulary rows; preserve all tokens and report frequency-bin conditional NLL and common-token regression
At least two held-out out-of-domain text corpora and a genuine low-frequency-token stratified challenge where actual eligible token counts and context coverage are disclosed
Official BLiMP 67 tasks (typically 1,000 pairs each), plus LAMBADA/ARC and relevant frequency bias/anisotropy
Monitor grouping costs, assigned frequencies/cluster members, optimizer state effects, folded-out inference throughput, train throughput/VRAM
reference_notes: Original dynamic weight kmeans/additive output row is Vuk's work: our hypothesis is gradient-based grouping, not the additive sharing itself.

Syntactic Smoothing EMNLP 2024: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.344/ ; if supervision/architecture cannot be matched, label as distinct recipe and do not assert exact parameter/compute fairness.
Extra vocab size/tied head/batch/K sweeps deferred; no 350M large-scale run now.
